# Play — Liber Abaci

- SudokuPad: [Liber Abaci on SudokuPad](https://sudokupad.)
- f-puzzles: [Liber Abaci on f-puzzles](https://www.f-puzzles.com/?)

Both links carry the same f-puzzles JSON (lz-string compressed) including the solution, so SudokuPad can check your answer.
Fibonacci lines are an invented rule, so neither site knows them. Each line is exported as a plain gold line with a gold
circle on its first cell (the dot you start reading from). The full rule is in the rules text.
Fallback: `puzzle.json` in this folder is the machine-readable source (givens, constraints, solution).
